rationale: diffusion_recon_dcstep_constrained_mayo_v4-claude-agentic: recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/ddpm_mayo_constrained_v4.pt, recon_mode=dps, recon_sample_steps=80, recon_eta=30.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_eta_clamp=False, recon_dcstep_every=5, recon_dcstep_n_cg=3, recon_dcstep_warmup=5, recon_dcstep_relax=1.0, recon_dc_solver=cg, val_n=70, train_n=0, rationale=iter-16 EMPTY-PATCH confirm from BASE_ITER=8 (max-SSIM canonical, T=80/val_n=70/eta=30/cg, ssim 0.85335 PSNR 30.488). EXHAUSTED: NFE swept 25..80 (sole SSIM lever, pinned at val_n=70 budget floor under 20min wall); eta {1,30} 30 is operating pt, 1 drops to 0.8388; relax {0.3,1.0} inert at low eta; iters10-15 are 6 bit-identical reproductions. Only remaining lever is OUT-OF-SCOPE v5 EMA-prior retrain (new ckpt). KEEP recon_dc_solver=cg.
